sentences.en: Grapes grow in thick clusters that are easy to pick.
sentences.zh: 葡萄成串生长，很容易采摘。

sentences.en: The cluster of cells continued to grow in the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 这些细胞群在实验室里继续生长。

sentences.en: Sami saw a cluster of kids standing on the balcony.
sentences.zh: 萨米看到一群孩子站在阳台上。

senses.zh: 使聚集；聚集在某人的周围
